title: A Birthday Visitor
setting: A garden with a small table behind a house.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

sentences.en: Mia comes to Ben's house for his birthday.
sentences.zh: 米娅来本家给他过生日。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) arrives at the door with a wrapped gift, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) in a paper party hat welcoming her.

sentences.en: They wait for the cake at a garden table.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在花园的桌边等蛋糕。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) sit at a small garden table with empty plates and forks, looking toward the house door.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them sitting at a table with empty plates; waiting for the cake can only be guessed.

sentences.en: Mia puts butter on warm bread for Ben.
sentences.zh: 米娅给本在热面包上抹黄油。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) spreads butter on a slice of bread for Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) at the garden table.

sentences.en: Just then, a little pig comes near them.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一只小猪走到他们身边。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small pink pig trots up close to the garden table where Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) sit.

sentences.en: The hungry animal finds a carrot under the table.
sentences.zh: 这只饿坏了的动物在桌子底下找到一根胡萝卜。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small pink pig sniffs an orange carrot on the grass under the garden table.

sentences.en: It eats all of the carrot very fast.
sentences.zh: 它飞快地把整根胡萝卜都吃光了。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small pink pig quickly munches the carrot, only the green top left on the grass.

sentences.en: Then it pulls the bread off Ben's plate.
sentences.zh: 接着它把本盘子里的面包拽走了。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small pink pig pulls a buttered slice of bread off the plate of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), who looks surprised.

sentences.en: Later, Ben closes the gate so it stays out.
sentences.zh: 后来，本关上了大门，让它待在外面。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) closes the garden gate while a small pink pig stands outside it, Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) laughing.
